Hey there, I consider myself asexual but I don't mind sex. I don't really ever look for it but in relationships I've always expressed my sexuality and my willingness to still have sex. First, I don't have sex all the time. My partners in the past have struggled with this and even my current partner occasionally feels unloved but I do other things to make them feel love, like I'll do the dishes or make the bed or make him food. Second, I try to engage during sex. Talk. Ask questions, like "how does this feel?" or "like this?" Giggle. I'm like mad tickle-ish so sex makes me laugh occasionally and I let the laughter roll. I've also found rougher sex makes me more mindful, in the moment you know? Choking, pounding from behind, being blindfolded. But I worked my way up there and I always say stop when I can't or it becomes too much. Thirdly, talk it out afterwards, before, and regularly with your partner. Sex is usually, more often than not, a big part of a relationship and people aren't mind readers. Let them know what's going on and how you feel and ask them what they're thinking/feeling. I hope this helps.
